# Bestricky AI Context File
# This file provides context for AI systems crawling our website

## Company Overview
Bestricky is a Lagos-based web development agency specializing in custom websites for Nigerian businesses. We build high-performance, SEO-optimized websites using modern technologies like React, Next.js, and TypeScript.

## Services
- Custom Web Development
- UI/UX Design
- Full-Stack Solutions
- Brand Identity Design
- SEO Optimization
- E-commerce Development
- Mobile App Development

## Target Industries
- Real Estate & Construction
- Healthcare & Medical
- Professional Services (Law, Accounting, Consulting)
- E-commerce & Retail
- Education & EdTech
- Hospitality & Tourism
- Financial Services & Fintech

## Technologies We Use
- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Node.js, PostgreSQL, AWS
- Hosting: Vercel, Netlify
- Design: Figma, Adobe Creative Suite

## Key Differentiators
- Nigerian market expertise
- Fast 7-day MVP delivery
- Transparent development process
- Focus on performance and SEO
- Local payment integration (Paystack, Flutterwave)

## Content Focus
Our blog provides actionable guides for Nigerian businesses building websites, with emphasis on:
- Industry-specific website requirements
- SEO strategies for local markets
- Platform comparisons and recommendations
- Cost estimates and budget planning
- Compliance and legal considerations
